content:
General
* Please switch the puzzle's status to WIP to allow more time for reviewers to review it.

Title / Goal / Input
* Please remove the name "Triki", as it's not necessary for solving the puzzle.

Goal / Input / Output / Constraints
* Please replace all `monospace` formatting with {{constant}} formatting, as the former introduces unnecessary line breaks and makes the content difficult to read.

Goal
* Packet format: Please change "GX", "GY", etc. to "[[gx]]", "[[gy]]", etc. for consistency.

* "signed 16-bit integers in little-endian order": Please specify the signed integer representation to be used (e.g. two's complement, ones' complement, or another representation).

* Gesture detection formulas: Please express the formulas in plain English rather than mathematical notation, as the latter can be copied and pasted directly into solution code in some programming languages.

* Please replace both instances of ">=" with "≥".

* Please add "and" after "G ≥ 400" to make it clear that both conditions must be satisfied.

* Please remove the final sentence.

Input
* Please specify that hexadecimal digits are uppercase, where applicable.

Constraints
* Please remove all constraints except for the first one and the final one to avoid repetition.

* Please change 100000 to 10 as [[N]] never exceeds 10 in the actual cases.

Stub generator
* Line 2: Please use loopline instead, as follows:

loop N loopline 14 [variable name of your choice]:word(2)

(Insert an appropriate variable name in place of the placeholder.)

Cases
* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario, using similar inputs. Accordingly,

  • Please revise Validator 4 so that its output is also "LOCKED" , matching Test 4.

  • Please advise whether the other test/validator pairs cover the same scenario. If they do, please list the scenario covered by each pair.

Thanks.

Thanks for making the revisions. Most of the changes look good. A few points remain

Title
* The title still contains the name "Triki", despite the title having been changed. This appears to be a bug on CG, so I'll raise a bug report with them.

Goal
* Duplicate filtering: The term "last accepted gesture" is somewhat ambiguous because "accepted" hasn't been explicitly defined. Also, "last" could potentially be misunderstood as "final". I suggest the following alternative wording:

-----
Append a gesture character to the password only if it differs from the previously appended gesture character.

Ignored packets do not reset the previously appended gesture character.
-----

Cases
* The final test/validator pair now correctly cover the same scenario (LOCKED) in both cases.

  Could you also clarify what scenario each of the first three test/validator pairs is intended to cover?

Thanks.
